Hi，

I am trying to use MSstats according to the tutorial downloaded from the https://skyline.gs.washington.edu/labkey/skyts/home/software/Skyline/tools/toolDetails.view?name=MSstats.

Even though I use that material and setting, there are errors in skyline as described below.

How to fix it?

 =======================================
 ** Reading the data for MSstats.....

 =======================================
 ** Data Processing for analysis.....
Error in dataProcess(raw, normalization = inputnormalize, nameStandards = standardpepname, :

  unused arguments (nameStandards = standardpepname, fillIncompleteRows = (inputmissingpeaks == "TRUE"))
Error in quantData$GROUP_ORIGINAL :
  $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

 Can't finish analysis.

messages.body_plain:
Dear Zhou,

Sorry for inconvenience.
>From this error message, I suspect that installation seems not completely or input format has problem. Could you share two files with me?
 1. 'msstats.log' file under the folder which has .sky file
 2. msstats input file : you can generate File> Export > Report > choose 'MSstats input'. Then you can set up the location and file name for this MSstats input file. Then 'MSstats input.csv' file can be generated.

If you can share with these files (you can post here or send me directly), it will be helpful for finding the issue.

Thanks,

--Meena

messages.body_plain:
Thanks you Meena，
I think there is a problem on the input file title which is determined by Skyline as described in appendix. For example, there is space in the "Protein Name" (ProteinName). The MSstats require "Intensity" and skyline output "Area".

I use R script with "MSstats.daily" package instead of Skyline to run the MSstats. It seems more powerful.

Best Regards
Baojin
